items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: Big Eye? Well, Big Eye wasn't in class with them. He wasn't nothing to tell the truth until he left from him.

ctx.x: How did Big Eye rank with the others? Was he in the class with all of the others?
Big Eye? Well, Big Eye wasn't in class with them. He wasn't nothing to tell the truth until he left from him.
Big Eye. You mean Big Ard. Big Eye.
